"""Test to verify the public API requirements."""
import semver

class TestReplaceFunction:
    def test_replace_exists(self):
        assert hasattr(semver, 'replace'), "replace function not found in semver module"
        assert callable(semver.replace), "replace is not callable"
    
    def test_replace_basic(self):
        result = semver.replace("1.2.3", major=2)
        assert result == "2.2.3", f"Expected '2.2.3', got {result!r}"
    
    def test_replace_multiple(self):
        result = semver.replace("1.2.3", major=2, minor=3, patch=4)
        assert result == "2.3.4", f"Expected '2.3.4', got {result!r}"
    
    def test_replace_prerelease(self):
        result = semver.replace("1.2.3-alpha.1", prerelease="beta.2")
        assert result == "1.2.3-beta.2", f"Expected '1.2.3-beta.2', got {result!r}"
    
    def test_replace_build(self):
        result = semver.replace("1.2.3+build.1", build="build.2")
        assert result == "1.2.3+build.2", f"Expected '1.2.3+build.2', got {result!r}"


class TestVersionInfoReplace:
    def test_replace_method_exists(self):
        v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
        assert hasattr(v, 'replace'), "replace method not found on VersionInfo"
        assert callable(v.replace), "replace is not callable"
    
    def test_replace_major(self):
        v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, "alpha.1", "build.1")
        v2 = v.replace(major=2)
        assert v2.major == 2
        assert v2.minor == 2
        assert v2.patch == 3
        assert v2.prerelease == "alpha.1"
        assert v2.build == "build.1"
    
    def test_immutability(self):
        v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
        v2 = v.replace(major=5)
        assert v.major == 1, "Original VersionInfo should not be modified"
        assert v2.major == 5
    
    def test_replace_returns_versioninfo(self):
        v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
        v2 = v.replace(major=2)
        assert isinstance(v2, semver.VersionInfo)


class TestPublicNames:
    def test_createparser_exists(self):
        assert hasattr(semver, 'createparser')
        assert callable(semver.createparser)
    
    def test_main_exists(self):
        assert hasattr(semver, 'main')
        assert callable(semver.main)
    
    def test_process_exists(self):
        assert hasattr(semver, 'process')
        assert callable(semver.process)
    
    def test_createparser_returns_parser(self):
        parser = semver.createparser()
        from argparse import ArgumentParser
        assert isinstance(parser, ArgumentParser)
EOF
